title: Employer letter - change of shift schedule
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Synthetic test document. It follows the structure of the real document type but is not an actual letter from any organisation.
summary_en: From October 5, 2026 the employee's shifts move to Tuesday-Saturday, 6:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.; the employee is asked to confirm by September 25 or speak with the manager.
text:
Maple Foods Distribution (fictional)
September 12, 2026
Dear Joseph Mensah,
Beginning Monday, October 5, 2026, your regular schedule will change to Tuesday to Saturday, 6:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Your hourly rate and benefits are unchanged.
Please confirm that you accept the new schedule by September 25, 2026, or speak with your manager if the change creates a problem for you.
Human Resources
